findings.message: The standalone HeatChill step does not identify a vessel and conflates the block's preheated condition with reaction heating. Preserve block preheating as an unmapped operational detail; the following HeatChill step already represents heating the reaction at 80 °C for 12 h.
The GC/MS completion check before solvent removal is absent. Preserve it as an unmapped action because the allowed operations do not represent analytical monitoring.

value.reason: The aluminum block was preheated to 80 °C before reactor placement; apparatus preheating is not represented as a separate reaction-vessel HeatChill operation.
Completion was judged by GC/MS before THF removal; analytical monitoring is not represented by an allowed operation.
